scope: Inventory of every macOS issue returned by the open issue query. An open issue or passing fixture is not full product qualification; no GitHub issues are closed by this local report.

prerequisites.signing: Five installed macOS profiles; zero unexpired app/helper/camera matches. No Developer ID distribution artifact, notarization, or extension/driver installation.

validation.shippingApp: Unsigned arm64 build and bundle/sandbox declaration audit passed
validation.diagnosticLifecycle: Shipping workspace fixture passed pre-view/hidden/detached sampling and retired-runtime sample fencing
validation.guestControllerHealth: Actual renderer/controller fixture passed waiting camera, separately inactive unapproved screen and retired unavailable sources
validation.colorTransforms: Native Core Image key/alpha, LUT channel/intensity/color-space and bypass passed; 1011 fractional-alpha edge pixels
validation.recoveryOutputs: See MACOS_RECOVERY_OUTPUT_QUALIFICATION.md for16 successful native media, storage, sandbox and transport scenarios
validation.guestMedia: Actual H264/Opus receive, mixer, Program/ISO decoded PCM identity, stereo return and private messages through local TURN/Chrome passed; see NATIVE_GUEST_ROUTING.md
validation.controllers: Native automation/shortcuts/MIDI/OSC/local-control/macros, saved slots and owned SwiftUI manager passed; Stream Deck8 tests, typecheck, universal helper, official packaging passed
validation.nativeInterviewProgramISO: Actual manager/default native receiver through local TURN/Chrome decoded Program and guest ISO:316946/294390 identical Float32 values, zero rational cue difference/history misses; separate screen approval/stop and Backstage privacy pass
validation.guestPrivateMessages: Actual shipping dispatcher/manager/default receiver through local TURN/Chrome passes both directions/receipts, private Backstage routes, rejoin history wipe and stale-context refusal alongside unchanged stereo audio return
validation.review: Independent subagent found no actionable lifecycle/cross-branch issue in runtime diagnostics; independently compiled exact integrated frame-store regression passed
validation.performance: Four ten-second12-layer H264/AAC workloads complete with valid decoded tracks and zero recorder drops; actual28.68/28.98/59.47/29.98fps. See PERFORMANCE_BASELINE_2026-10-21.json; physical/sustained/Intel qualification remains open.
